baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic subject is followed by two coordinated imperfect verbs, يُبْدِئُ and يُعِيدُ, whose objects are left open.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first verb supplies origination or precedence and the second supplies return after departure or a second performance. Their coordination gives one agent control of both the first emergence and the re-emergence, without requiring the returned object to be named.

activation_trace.role: Beginning paired with return supplies the two-phase frame and allows the pair to range over action, creation, or speech.
Return after departure and doing again supplies the second phase as an actual recovery or renewed performance, not merely resemblance.

changed_reading.after: He governs a complete arc from first emergence through disappearance or departure to renewed presence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exact verb pair can belong to the domain of beginning speech and returning an answer.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch explicitly preserves the negative idiom for someone who neither begins nor replies. The positive assertion reverses that idiom: the emphatic subject is not silent but initiates address and returns an answer. This coexists with the ontological reading because the paired-beginning branch itself spans speech, action, and creation.

activation_trace.role: The branch's pairing of beginning and return in speech licenses an utterance-opening function for يُبْدِئُ.
The silence idiom, 'neither begins nor replies,' is positively reversed so يُعِيدُ can function as answering back or resuming speech.

changed_reading.before: The pair only describes making beings twice.
changed_reading.after: The pair can also assert an active voice: He opens the address and gives the returning answer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both verbs are imperfect and coordinated as a stable predicate of the emphatic subject.
baseline_models.mechanism: Origination is not confined to a remote first act, while return is not confined to a single final repetition. The branch of acquired habit and persistence lets the pair describe a dependable disposition: repeatedly opening new acts and renewing what has run its course.

activation_trace.role: Opening an act and making it a point of origin supplies each fresh initiation in an ongoing pattern.
Habit, training, and persistence turn return into a dependable recurrent mode rather than one isolated sequel.

changed_reading.before: A first creation is followed once by a second creation.
changed_reading.after: Initiating and renewing are continuously available modes of agency, capable of recurring whenever a course needs reopening.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The beginning branch can depict setting out from one land, while the return branch can name a destination, return-place, or return-time.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pair can be spatialized as dispatch and retrieval. The first verb establishes a point of departure; the second does more than reverse motion by assigning the place or time in which the trajectory comes home.

activation_trace.role: Starting out from one land to another supplies departure from an assigned origin.
Destination and return-place or return-time supply a determined terminus for what was sent forth.

changed_reading.before: He repeats the same act at a later moment.
changed_reading.after: He sends a course out from its origin and appoints the destination into which it returns.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening-return pair becomes a scheduled arc. A marked celestial season and celestial stations provide indices, the day supplies bounded duration, and the promise supplies an appointed time or place. Return is therefore not an unsignaled loop but a recurrence whose endpoint has already been marked.

activation_trace.role: Beginning paired with return provides the focus ayah's cycle to be temporally indexed.
Counted time and recurrence supply an appointed rhythm latent in the packet's non-dominant mapping of the focus return-root.
A marked season at which people gather turns the sky cue into a temporal marker rather than mere height.
Celestial stations supply a visible ordered series through which recurrence can be tracked.
A duration of time gives the returning arc a bounded temporal field.
A promise fixed to a time or place supplies the cycle's declared appointment.

structural_cues: The context opens with a sky bearing stations and immediately narrows to a promised day.
The focus pair later places beginning and return under one emphatic subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: marked season, celestial stations, bounded time, and an appointment. Reader arrow: these cues index the return as scheduled recurrence. Live alternative: the oath images establish solemnity without specifying the mechanism of the focus verbs.

changed_reading.before: He can originate and repeat without any implied schedule.
changed_reading.after: He opens a cycle whose return is already indexed by signs and bound to an appointment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speech-and-reply baseline becomes forensic. An act first occurs in the witnessed field; it then returns as a knowledgeable statement about itself. The same event is thus both initiated as deed and re-presented as evidence, making يُعِيدُ an answerability mechanism rather than only physical recreation.

activation_trace.role: Beginning in action or speech supplies the first presentation of the deed.
The reply side of the reversed silence idiom supplies the deed's return as an answering account.
Presence with direct seeing establishes a field in which an occurrence remains available to testimony.
The production of an act supplies the event that will later answer for itself.
A declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the authoritative re-presentation of the act.

structural_cues: 85:3 pairs witness and witnessed; 85:7 makes the actors witnesses of what they do; 85:9 closes the sequence with comprehensive witnessing.
The focus verbs leave their object unstated, so an act or account can occupy that slot.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an enacted deed, direct witnessing, and knowledgeable declaration. Reader arrow: the witnessed deed is returned as evidentiary speech. Live alternative: witnessing only guarantees knowledge and does not alter the creation-return pair.

changed_reading.before: He begins speech and returns an answer.
changed_reading.after: He brings a deed into occurrence and returns that occurrence as testimony that answers its doer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The narrative converts neutral recurrence into causal reversal. Human agents initiate lethal, burning action; repudiation is followed by punishment; the testing fire separates and exposes; and forceful seizure closes the sequence immediately before the focus. What agents send into the world can be returned to them in judged form.

activation_trace.role: Opening an act supplies the causal first move whose consequences can later be returned.
Return after departure supplies the feedback motion by which an initiated deed comes back in another phase.
Taking life supplies the irreversible human action that demands a non-neutral second phase.
Producing an act identifies the persecutors as initiators within the causal chain.
Punishment following repudiation supplies an explicit delayed-consequence image.
Burning and blackening by fire supply a transformed return of the persecutors' own chosen medium.
Forceful overpowering seizure supplies the closing reversal immediately before the focus assertion.

structural_cues: The context moves from victims being killed, through perpetrators acting and watching, to threatened fire and a severe seizure.
85:12 directly precedes the focus and makes the subject's two verbs answer a claim about forceful taking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: initiated violence, delayed punishment, fire, and overpowering seizure. Reader arrow: the second focus verb returns an action's consequence toward its initiator. Live alternative: the sequence only illustrates power, while يُعِيدُ refers exclusively to recreating life.

changed_reading.before: He starts life and later restores life.
changed_reading.after: He also closes moral causation: an enacted force can return upon its initiator as a judged consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The habitual-renewal baseline acquires a hydraulic model. Origination opens a channel; return is recurrent replenishment that keeps provision moving through a sheltered garden. The pair can therefore describe sustained source activity between first creation and final recreation.

activation_trace.role: Opening and establishing an origin supplies the source from which a course begins.
Persistent habitual recurrence supplies repeated renewal of the opened course.
A garden sheltered by dense trees supplies the receiving ecology within which renewal remains productive.
Continuous movement and spreading supply the visible process rather than a static repeated object.
Continuing provision turns the returned phase into replenishment that sustains the flow.
Opening and widening until something flows provides the material arrow from initiation to sustained renewal.

structural_cues: 85:11 presents gardens whose rivers flow beneath them, a dynamic reward rather than a merely stored one.
The imperfect verbs in the focus can carry ongoing or recurrent force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: sheltered garden, running movement, continuing provision, and a channel opened to flow. Reader arrow: repeated return replenishes the source. Live alternative: the garden imagery names reward but does not specify how the focus pair operates.

changed_reading.before: Return is a second event after the first event ends.
changed_reading.after: Return can be continuous re-beginning, the recurrent supply by which an originated course keeps flowing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Judicial feedback is not the only possible return. The condition of failing to turn leaves a live fork; the later covering of sin and active love allow the return branch to carry compassionate benefit. The same initiating agency can return consequence or return protection and favor, depending on the relation that is resumed.

activation_trace.role: Opening an act also supplies the opening of a new relational course after rupture.
A favor, benefit, or compassionate kindness that comes back supplies a reparative mode of return.
Calling another to repent supplies an open invitation to reverse course before consequence hardens.
Covering a sin while protecting its bearer from the effect supplies restoration rather than mere erasure.
Love and affection supply the positive relation into which the returning movement can resolve.

structural_cues: 85:10 conditions punishment on not turning, while 85:14 follows the focus with forgiveness and love.
The focus repeats the emphatic pronoun pattern that 85:14 uses before naming the restorative attributes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an invited turning, protection from sin's effect, and love. Reader arrow: these cues define a restorative branch of what can be returned. Live alternative: forgiveness and love are independent attributes and do not specify the object of يُعِيدُ.

changed_reading.before: The return phase sends initiated violence back as punishment.
changed_reading.after: Return bifurcates: it can close violence judicially or reopen a broken relation through protection and returning favor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cycle is neither mechanical nor self-propelled. Possessive control supplies jurisdiction over the field, intensified doing supplies actual enactment, and will supplies selection. Beginning and return are deliberate operations of one agent, including the choice to renew differently rather than reproduce an identical copy.

activation_trace.role: Novel or unprecedented origination keeps the first phase open to genuine newness.
A second performance supplies re-enactment under agency rather than an autonomous loop.
Possession with power of disposal supplies control over what is begun and returned.
Bringing an act about supplies execution rather than merely potential capacity.
Will and volition supply the selector governing both origination and renewed performance.

structural_cues: 85:9 assigns the entire field to the subject's dominion.
85:16 intensifies doing and directly links it to what is willed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: control, enacted doing, and will. Reader arrow: these make recurrence intentionally selected and permit renewed difference. Live alternative: the cues prove capability while the focus still names one fixed creation-resurrection sequence.

changed_reading.before: Beginning naturally rolls into an automatic recurrence.
changed_reading.after: Each beginning and each return is a selected enactment; recurrence remains subject to will and can arrive as renewal, not duplication.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ontological pair crosses into narration. A past occurrence comes to the hearer as renewed speech, and a collective formation returns as a recognizable pattern. Beginning names an event's first happening; returning names its re-entry into the present through report and patterned recurrence.

activation_trace.role: The unprecedented new occurrence supplies history's first event.
Doing again after a beginning supplies the event's renewed presence or patterned recurrence.
Coming and arrival supply the report's movement from prior event into the hearer's present.
Something coming to be after not being supplies the first historical occurrence.
Speech renewed as news or report supplies a second mode in which the occurrence happens again.
A mutually supporting collective supplies the repeatable social formation carried by the report.

structural_cues: 85:17 asks whether the report has arrived, making an earlier event newly present as discourse.
The focus baseline already admits both event and speech domains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: arrival, first occurrence, renewed report, and collective formation. Reader arrow: narration returns an event to present efficacy and exposes a recurring social pattern. Live alternative: the report is only an example of divine power, not a realization of يُعِيدُ.

changed_reading.before: He originates entities and physically brings them back.
changed_reading.after: He can also let an event happen first and make it happen again in the present as report, warning, and recurring collective pattern.

context_deltas.mechanism: The departure-destination baseline becomes topological. Covering and hiding create the experience of getting beyond sight, but complete circling means every outward course remains inside the subject's domain. Return is closure of an encompassing circuit, not simply retracing a path backward.

activation_trace.role: Setting out from one land toward another supplies outward motion from an origin.
A determined destination or return-place supplies closure of the outward course.
Covering supplies apparent disappearance from the governing field.
Placing something behind appearance supplies hiddenness without actual removal.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and secure possession prevents concealed departure from becoming escape.
Circling supplies the geometry by which an outward trajectory closes back into return.

structural_cues: 85:19 places deniers inside denial, and 85:20 positions the subject behind and encompassing them.
The focus verbs share one emphatic subject, so departure and destination remain under the same agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: covering, hidden placement, complete possession, and circling. Reader arrow: apparent departure is a path within an enclosure whose closure is return. Live alternative: enclosure only threatens the deniers and has no spatial bearing on the focus pair.

changed_reading.before: He sends forth and later calls back along a linear path.
changed_reading.after: He originates motion within an encompassing field, so even concealed outward movement closes into its appointed return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speech baseline gains a storage-and-performance mechanism. An utterance is first brought forth, gathered into recitable form, held on a writable support, and preserved; each recitation returns it from conserved form into a new voiced event. Preservation is productive latency rather than static immobility.

activation_trace.role: Beginning paired with return in speech supplies first utterance and renewed performance.
Replying or resuming speech supplies the re-voicing side of the pair.
Reading, recitation, and causing another to read supply repeatable voiced performance.
A broad support used for writing supplies a durable material carrier between performances.
The preserved thing remaining fixed in mind supplies continuity of form through absence from sound.
Persistent observance supplies repeated reactivation rather than one-time storage.

structural_cues: 85:21 identifies a recitable discourse and 85:22 locates it in a preserved written support.
The positive focus pair can reverse the branch idiom of one who neither begins speech nor replies.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: recitation, writable support, fixed preservation, and persistent observance. Reader arrow: conserved form enables repeated voiced return. Live alternative: the closing verses only authenticate the discourse and do not realize the focus pair's speech sense.

changed_reading.before: He initiates speech and gives a direct answer.
changed_reading.after: He brings speech forth and returns it to lived time whenever its preserved form is voiced again.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of the focus return-root into counting vocabulary. It remains anchored at يُعِيدُ through an authorized mapped branch and coheres with the paired cycle; downstream prose should present it as a secondary structural echo, not as the verb's direct lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The second focus verb is packet-mapped not only to return but also, non-dominantly, to appointed counted recurrence.

activation_trace.role: The explicit beginning-return pairing supplies the cycle whose intervals may be counted.
Counted time and recurrence recast return as an appointed interval that comes due again.

changed_reading.before: Return is repetition at an unspecified later time.
changed_reading.after: Return may carry the faint structure of a due interval: recurrence measured, appointed, and brought around again.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The distributive-economic image is branch-distant from the surface verbs, but both halves remain anchored in focus inventories and gain support from reward as wages and continuing provision. Render it only as a material analogy for recompense, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A beginning can be the share assigned first, while a return can be a benefit or kindness that comes back.

activation_trace.role: The first-apportioned share materializes initiation as an initial allotment.
Benefit, gift, and returning kindness materialize the second phase as favorable recompense.
Wages or provision for work supplies the social relation connecting an initiated deed to a returned allotment.
Continuing provision keeps the returned benefit from being a single exhausted payment.

changed_reading.before: He makes an entity and then makes it again.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, He assigns the first share of a course and returns its yield as continuing benefit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is deliberately strange because the hidden-fire branch comes from the packet mapping of وَرَائِهِم, whose surface role is spatial. It remains useful as a cross-domain mechanism anchored by the focus return verb and the surah's explicit ignition cue; downstream prose must call it a latent-fire analogy, not a lexical reading of 'behind.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes novel emergence with return after absence, allowing a hidden capacity to flare as if new and then flare again.

activation_trace.role: The unprecedented new thing supplies the felt novelty of each ignition.
Return after departure supplies reactivation after the flame has disappeared from view.
Igniting and kindling fire provide the manifest activation event.
A fire latent in the flint and brought out by striking supplies persistence as hidden capacity between activations.

changed_reading.before: Beginning and return are two externally separate productions.
changed_reading.after: As a latent-fire analogy, what appears newly begun may be a conserved capacity made manifest, withdrawn from sight, and activated again.

strongest_changes: The paired verbs expand from a single creation-recreation sequence into deliberate control of a complete origin-return arc.
Witness and action cues make return forensic: a deed can come back as testimony and judged consequence.
The condition of turning followed by forgiveness and love preserves a coexisting restorative return rather than a punishment-only reading.
Flow, report, enclosure, recitation, and preservation expose distinct material, historical, spatial, and textual ways for something originated to become present again.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventories themselves contained two unusually productive disturbances: the positive reversal of the idiom for one who neither begins speech nor replies, and a non-dominant mapping from return into counted recurrence. Context then activated multiple nonexclusive mechanisms instead of selecting one: appointed cycle, evidentiary replay, causal reversal, continuous replenishment, compassionate restoration, willed re-enactment, historical narration, enclosed trajectory, and preserved speech re-performed.
remaining_uncertainties: The verbs' omitted objects keep creation, deeds, consequences, speech, and persons simultaneously possible but prevent any one object from being proven by syntax alone.
The forensic, hydraulic, topological, historical, and textual arrows are reader-supplied mechanisms connecting packet images; each has a live alternative in which context only demonstrates power.
The counted-interval and latent-ember readings depend on split or form-distant packet branches and should remain exploratory rather than become surface glosses.
